# QuickScan — AI Document Scanner & PDF Maker

> QuickScan is a fast, privacy-first AI document scanner app for iPhone (iOS 17+). Scan documents, IDs, receipts, contracts, and business cards to crisp PDFs in 3 seconds with on-device AI edge detection, background removal, OCR text extraction, and digital signatures. Works 100% offline with zero cloud uploads.

By Das Group LLC.

## Links
- Canonical page: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/quickscan/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755203492
- Full machine-readable context: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/quickscan/llms-full.txt
- Privacy policy: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/privacy/
- Portfolio: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/

## Core Capabilities
- 3-second AI document scanning with auto-edge detection, perspective correction, and background removal
- ID card and passport scanning with clean border extraction and text sharpening
- On-device OCR (Optical Character Recognition) via Apple Vision framework with text search and copy
- Automatic document classification into 10 types (receipts, invoices, contracts, IDs, tax docs, medical records, bank statements, forms, reports, letters)
- Digital signatures: draw, save, and place signatures directly on scanned PDFs
- Export formats: multi-page PDF, JPEG, PNG with customizable compression and metadata
- Siri Shortcuts & App Intents for voice-activated scanning and automation
- 100% on-device processing — zero cloud uploads, works fully offline

## Technical Specifications
- **App Store ID**: 6755203492
- **Bundle ID**: com.anishdas.pdfscanner
- **Platform**: iOS 17.0 or later (iPhone & iPad)
- **Programming Language**: Swift & SwiftUI
- **Computer Vision**: Apple Vision framework (VNRecognizeTextRequest, VNDetectRectanglesRequest)
- **Image Processing**: Apple CoreImage framework (CIColorControls, CIPerspectiveCorrection, CIAdaptiveThreshold)
- **NLP & Classification**: Apple NaturalLanguage framework (NLTagger, NLModel)
- **PDF Engine**: Apple PDFKit (PDFDocument, PDFPage)
- **Data Storage**: Local iOS app sandbox + encrypted iOS Keychain
- **Cloud Dependency**: 0% — No external APIs, no remote databases, no tracking pixels
